title: Julian Date Conversion
text: Calculate Julian date or modified Julian date, 1 input, 1 output, {Month} sets Month; {Year}, {Day}, {Hour}, {Minutes}, {Seconds}, {Calculate modified Julian date} sets the modified Julian data, {Time increment} and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Year
params.values: Year 2013 (default) | double, whole number, greater than 1

params.name: Month
params.values: Month January (default) | February | March | April | May | June | July | August | September | October | November | December

params.name: Time increment
params.values: Time increment Day (default) | Hour | Min | Sec | None

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
